quote: reduction of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
note: Single-ingredient latanoprost labels cover open-angle glaucoma, of which OPTN-related POAG is a subtype.

quote: diffuse posterior uveitis and choroiditis, optic neuritis, sympathetic ophthalmia
note: Optic neuritis is listed among ophthalmic diseases on single-ingredient prednisolone labels.

quote: Fluoxetine capsules, USP are indicated for the acute and maintenance treatment of Major Depressive Disorder
note: MDD is a direct single-ingredient fluoxetine indication.

quote: Ergomar ® is indicated as therapy to abort or prevent vascular headache, e.g., migraine
note: Single-ingredient ergotamine (Ergomar) is indicated for migraine.

quote: 25% Dextrose Injection is indicated in the treatment of acute symptomatic episodes of hypoglycemia
note: Single-ingredient dextrose label directly indicates hypoglycemia.

quote: seasonal or perennial allergic rhinitis; asthma; contact dermatitis; atopic dermatitis
note: Single-ingredient prednisone covers allergic/atopic states, which atopic IgE responsiveness falls under (somewhat loose mapping).

quote: temporary relief of coughs and upper respiratory symptoms, including nasal congestion, associated with allergy or the common cold
note: Single-ingredient codeine is indicated only for pain; on the promethazine/phenylephrine/codeine label codeine supplies the cough relief, while the separately listed upper respiratory symptoms (nasal congestion, allergy) come from promethazine and phenylephrine.

quote: correction of hemodynamic imbalances present in the shock syndrome
note: Single-ingredient dopamine is indicated for shock.

quote: Cholera caused by Vibrio cholerae
note: Cholera is listed in single-ingredient doxycycline indications.

quote: indicated for the preventive treatment of migraine in patients 12 years of age and older
note: Single-ingredient topiramate is indicated for migraine prevention.

quote: Idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura in adults
note: Single-ingredient prednisone covers ITP (autoimmune thrombocytopenia).

quote: to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in adults with heart failure
note: Single-ingredient Jardiance covers heart failure broadly, including HFpEF as a subtype.

quote: adult patients with advanced renal cell carcinoma
note: Single-ingredient nivolumab (Opdivo) is indicated for RCC.

quote: management of severe and persistent pain that requires an extended treatment period with a daily opioid analgesic
note: Single-ingredient buprenorphine transdermal covers severe persistent pain, of which spine pain is a specific instance.

quote: including pyelonephritis and cystitis (initial and recurrent)
note: Single-ingredient aztreonam lists cystitis under UTIs.

quote: Retinyl palmitate injection is effective for the treatment of vitamin A deficiency
note: Vitamin A deficiency (a vitamin deficiency disorder) is a single-ingredient indication.

quote: temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to: headache
note: Single-ingredient OTC naproxen relieves headache, covering tension-type headache.

quote: Relieves sinus congestion and pressure, helps decongest sinus opening
note: Sinus congestion appears only on combination products and belongs to the decongestant partner (e.g. phenylephrine), not acetaminophen.

quote: For relief of the signs and symptoms of rheumatoid arthritis
note: Single-ingredient diclofenac labels indicate rheumatoid arthritis (and on Arthrotec it is diclofenac's own NSAID effect).

quote: PERIKABIVEN may be used to prevent essential fatty acid deficiency
note: No single-ingredient text; EFAD prevention on the parenteral nutrition combination comes from the lipid emulsion, not the amino acid L-valine.

quote: acute gouty arthritis; acute rheumatic carditis; ankylosing spondylitis
note: Only in combination text, but the product is betamethasone sodium phosphate plus betamethasone acetate (two salts of DRUG), so the indication is DRUG's own.

quote: Angina at rest including: Vasospastic (Prinzmetal's variant) angina Unstable (crescendo, pre-infarction) angina 2. Chronic stable angina
note: Single-ingredient verapamil is indicated for angina.

quote: indicated for remission induction in acute non-lymphocytic leukemia of adults and pediatric patients
note: Acute non-lymphocytic leukemia = AML; the t(3;5) AML is a subtype on the single-ingredient label.

quote: Oral Olanzapine and fluoxetine in combination is indicated for the treatment of treatment resistant depression
note: The olanzapine single-ingredient label itself lists treatment-resistant depression (used with fluoxetine), so it is olanzapine's own labeled indication.

quote: For relief of mild to moderate pain
note: Single-ingredient diclofenac covers mild to moderate pain generally, which includes greater trochanteric pain syndrome (a loose, generic-pain mapping).

quote: effective for the treatment of thiamine deficiency or beriberi
note: Single-ingredient thiamine is indicated for beriberi.

quote: Pentazocine and Naloxone Tablets are indicated for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic
note: Naloxone alone is indicated only for opioid overdose reversal; the analgesic indication on pentazocine/naloxone belongs to pentazocine.

quote: for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma
note: Single-ingredient pembrolizumab covers melanoma; eyelid melanoma is a site-specific subtype.

quote: adult patients with advanced renal cell carcinoma
note: Papillary RCC is a subtype of RCC indicated on single-ingredient nivolumab.

quote: Amlodipine besylate and atorvastatin calcium tablets are indicated in patients for whom treatment with both amlodipine and atorvastatin is appropriate
note: The hypertension indication is found only on the amlodipine/atorvastatin label and belongs to amlodipine.

quote: Nosocomial pneumonia in adult and pediatric patients 2 months of age and older
note: Only on the piperacillin/tazobactam label, but piperacillin is the antibacterial agent there (tazobactam is the beta-lactamase inhibitor), so the indication is attributable to DRUG.

quote: Angina Pectoris Due to Coronary Atherosclerosis
note: Single-ingredient atenolol is indicated for angina pectoris.

quote: indicated in the treatment of surface ocular bacterial infections, including acute bacterial conjunctivitis, and blepharoconjunctivitis
note: Both polymyxin B and trimethoprim on this label are antibacterials, so polymyxin B shares the indication; its single-ingredient label also covers eye infections ('infections of the eye caused by susceptible strains of Ps. aeruginosa').

quote: Angina Pectoris
note: Single-ingredient metoprolol is indicated for angina pectoris (and acute MI); intermediate coronary syndrome (unstable angina) is treated as a subtype, though the label does not name unstable angina.

quote: 1.3 Urinary Tract Infections Sulfamethoxazole and Trimethoprim Injection is indicated in the treatment of severe or complicated urinary tract inf
note: No single-ingredient text, but in SMX/TMP both components are antibacterials acting together, so the UTI indication is attributable to sulfamethoxazole.

quote: PERIKABIVEN may be used to prevent essential fatty acid deficiency
note: No single-ingredient text; EFAD prevention on the parenteral nutrition combination comes from the lipid emulsion, not aspartic acid.

quote: Primary or secondary adrenocortical insufficiency (hydrocortisone or cortisone is the first choice
note: Single-ingredient hydrocortisone is indicated for secondary adrenocortical insufficiency.

quote: Reduce the risk of acute urinary retention
note: Single-ingredient finasteride is indicated to reduce the risk of acute urinary retention in BPH.

quote: Complicated Urinary Tract Infection and Pyelonephritis in Pediatric Patients
note: Single-ingredient ciprofloxacin covers pyelonephritis, of which chronic pyelonephritis is a subtype.

quote: II. Hypertension Nicardipine hydrochloride capsules are indicated for the treatment of hypertension
note: Single-ingredient nicardipine is indicated for hypertension.
